A network of three '''Imperial defense satellites''' were stationed in orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sirpar/Legends|Sirpar]]. They were armed with a single [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]]-scale [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] and two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].
